invariants.rationale: The method always initializes and returns a Map instance; it never returns null.
The result is always a Map<String, List<String>> as per method signature and construction.
The writeResult parameter is required for the processing in the method and likely checked by callers.
If the result Map is not empty, all its values (List<String>) are filled by getAllExistingFileIds and should not be null.
Each list in the result is either created by getAllExistingFileIds or the Map is empty, so no value should be null.
